name: limit-number-length-over-limit
description: A start_year literal of 1234567.890123456, 17 characters as written, is refused before schema validation ever inspects the non-integer year.
notes: The literal's magnitude (about 1.23 million) is well within the safe-integer range, and only its 17-character length violates the limit, so exactly one refusal behaviour is under test, not a magnitude or type conflation. The literal is also not an integer, which would ordinarily be a schema_violation for a year field; because the number-length check runs at the strict parse stage, before schema validation, the input is refused as input_limit_exceeded instead. input_bytes is required so the exact 17-character spelling is preserved rather than reformatted by a JSON writer.
